abstain.headline: There is not enough history to compare this result.
questions_to_ask_your_doctor: Can this result be compared with an earlier test?
When should I have my next blood test?
Who should I contact if I have questions before then?
abstain.recommended_action: Ask your care team to review this result.
abstain.what_this_means: This tool needs an earlier result to compare changes over time. That information is not in the record yet. Your care team can review this result and decide what to do next.

escalate.headline: Your care team should review this change.
questions_to_ask_your_doctor: What follow-up test or scan do you recommend to check this result?
Could another health issue or medicine cause this change?
What symptoms or changes should I look out for right now?
escalate.recommended_action: Ask your care team to review this result.
escalate.what_this_means: This tool found a change from earlier recorded tests. It cannot tell why the number changed or diagnose a health problem. Your care team can review this result with other tests and your full history.

explained.headline: This tool did not flag a large change.
questions_to_ask_your_doctor: Does my routine monitoring schedule stay the same?
Are there any new symptoms I should report before my next visit?
When is my next scheduled blood test or clinic appointment?
explained.recommended_action: Ask your care team if your monitoring plan is unchanged.
explained.verbal_band: Model output found no large change
explained.what_this_means: This tool compares this result with earlier recorded tests. It cannot confirm or rule out a health problem. Your care team can review this result with your full history.

needs_repeat.headline: Your care team should review this result.
questions_to_ask_your_doctor: When and where should I repeat this blood test?
Are there any special instructions before my next blood draw?
What specific symptoms should I watch for while waiting for the repeat test?
needs_repeat.recommended_action: Ask your care team whether another blood test is needed.
needs_repeat.verbal_band: Model output asks for more review
needs_repeat.what_this_means: This tool found a pattern that needs more review. It cannot tell why the number changed or if it is a lab issue. Your care team can decide if another blood test is right.

false_alarm_explained.clinical_context: Patient on surveillance. CA 15-3 increases from 20 to 23 U/mL (1.15x), below RCV threshold.
false_alarm_explained.narrative: Under the model assumptions, the real-change probability is 1%. Under the model assumptions, the gross-error probability is 0%. Under the model assumptions, the stable-component probability is 98%. The biological reference change value threshold is 31%. The observed marker ratio is 1.15 relative to baseline. The recommended clinical action is explained.
false_alarm_explained.title: Benign Fluctuation: Biological Noise Within RCV Adjudicated as Explained

j2_surprising_repeat.clinical_context: Patient on surveillance with stable CA 15-3 (~18 U/mL). Day 360 shows sudden jump to 180 U/mL.
j2_surprising_repeat.narrative: Under the model assumptions, the real-change probability is 0%. Under the model assumptions, the gross-error probability is 100%. Under the model assumptions, the stable-component probability is 0%. The biological reference change value threshold is 31%. The observed marker ratio is 10.00 relative to baseline. The recommended clinical action is needs_repeat.
j2_surprising_repeat.title: Journey J2: Surprising Marker Spike (Analytical Error) Adjudicated to Repeat

real_progression_escalate.clinical_context: Patient on surveillance. CA 15-3 surges from 15 to 37.8 U/mL (2.5x), exceeding RCV.
real_progression_escalate.narrative: Under the model assumptions, the real-change probability is 99%. Under the model assumptions, the gross-error probability is 1%. Under the model assumptions, the stable-component probability is 0%. The biological reference change value threshold is 31%. The observed marker ratio is 2.50 relative to baseline. The recommended clinical action is escalate.
real_progression_escalate.title: True Recurrence: Biomarker Elevation Exceeding RCV Adjudicated to Escalate
